rules.statement: Section 29 does not provide any relevant provision.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. There is nothing in section 29 (2) which expressly or impliedly, excludes the operation of section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance. Per Atukorale, J. (P/CA) "Where, as in the instant case, the letting of the residential premises is for a period of not less than 5 years, I am of the opinion that the formalities prescribed by section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance should be observed.' 361 2. As the agreement had not been notarially executed it was invalid in law. Hence, the tenant had not contravened section 29 (3) of the Rent Act by failure to vacate the premises at the end of the period specified in the agreement. As such she could not be convicted of an offence under section 42 (2) of the Act

rules.statement: An agreement for the letting of residential premises for at least five years must comply with the formalities prescribed by section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance.

rules.statement: A tenant cannot be convicted of an offence under section 42 if she fails to vacate the premises at the end of the period specified in the agreement as she is covered by the provisions of the Rent Act.
